I posted the answer in #coastal-team. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on November 3, 2025.

- **Sources:** Moss's 11/2/2025 Coastal digest says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." Bettina's own Dec 8, 2025 cutover recap gives the same official date.
- **Day-to-day ownership:** That recap also says Bettina kept running the account until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 22 if the tracker wants who actually ran the account rather than the official handoff.
